summary: Every ChatGPT Free account ($0, no credit card) includes limited access to Codex, OpenAI's coding agent, across its clients (desktop app Codex mode, CLI, IDE extension, web). The free tier runs GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI's cheapest model) and gives limited access to GPT-5.6 Terra in Work and Codex on desktop; the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol is not available on Free. OpenAI does not publish numeric free quotas - usage draws from a shared allowance with rolling reset windows, visible in the usage dashboard. Note 'Luna Max' is not a separate model: it means GPT-5.6 Luna running at the 'max' reasoning-effort setting, which ships disabled by default in Codex settings.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a free ChatGPT account at chatgpt.com - no credit card needed.
Launch any Codex client (ChatGPT desktop app Codex mode, Codex CLI, IDE extension, or chatgpt.com/codex) and sign in with your ChatGPT account.
Select GPT-5.6 Luna as the model - it is available on the Free plan (Terra is limited to Work/Codex-on-desktop; Sol requires a paid plan).
Optional: enable the hidden 'max' reasoning effort under Settings > Configuration > Available reasoning efforts (it is off by default, per community guides - not documented on OpenAI's help pages).
Track consumption with /status in the CLI or the usage dashboard at chatgpt.com/codex/settings/usage; Free accounts cannot buy credit top-ups, so wait for the window reset.
